Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
* A vamp in torpor can't get blood from a Hunting Ground, correct?

* Cat's Guidance - is it played before or after resulting combat from
a successful block?
I seem to remember that it is played after the combat, but I couldn't
find any reference to that.

* Mask 1k Faces - Jost Werner bleeds at +1 stealth (as per his special).
Prey declines to block because they don't have the requisite intercept.
Dimple then Masks the (now successful bleed) action.
Is this legal? If so, can the Prey attempt to block now that the action
is
at 0 stealth?

Sorrow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Sorrow" <cbo...@apdi.net> wrote:
> * A vamp in torpor can't get blood from a Hunting Ground, correct?

Correct. A vampire in torpor is not "ready", and HGs only feed "ready"
vampires, by card text.

> * Cat's Guidance - is it played before or after resulting combat from
> a successful block?
> I seem to remember that it is played after the combat, but I couldn't
> find any reference to that.

Inferior: after, yes.

> * Mask 1k Faces - Jost Werner bleeds at +1 stealth (as per his special).
> Prey declines to block because they don't have the requisite intercept.
> Dimple then Masks the (now successful bleed) action.
> Is this legal?

Yes.

> If so, can the Prey attempt to block now that the action
> is at 0 stealth?

No, since she has already declined to block and Mask doesn't create
another block-opportunity-window.

--

Messages.Author: Patrick Harris
Messages.Body:
Sorrow wrote:

> * A vamp in torpor can't get blood from a Hunting Ground, correct?

Correct. I believe the text states 'ready' vampire. Torporized vamps aren't
ready.

>
>
> * Cat's Guidance - is it played before or after resulting combat from
> a successful block?
> I seem to remember that it is played after the combat, but I couldn't
> find any reference to that.
>

I have always played if directly after the block succeeds (before combat), as a
minion has to be untapped to play a reaction card (unless the card states...).
So I would assume the reacting vampire, if successful in blocking, plays the
Cat's Guidance and untaps. Then he enters combat with the acting minion
untapped.

> * Mask 1k Faces - Jost Werner bleeds at +1 stealth (as per his special).
> Prey declines to block because they don't have the requisite intercept.
> Dimple then Masks the (now successful bleed) action.

> Is this legal? If so, can the Prey attempt to block now that the action
> is
> at 0 stealth?
>

That's a tough one. Does the original action, which was at +1 stealth,
continue at +1 stealth? Either way, I'd say the Prey can't block because
he/she has already declined. The Mask would be like a Bonding or other
modifier that was added after the Prey declined.

Hope I got all that correct,
p.

The action is not "bleed at +1 stealth", it is "bleed".
Dimple could've begun such an action.

Likewise, if Ozmo begins a bleed action, the action will have
+1 bleed (Ozmo's bonus). Dimple may Mask that action, as well.

> Of course, if he
> just say "I don't block", it doesn't matter, but couldn't phrasing
> change that around, ie. "i try and fail to block" guaranteeing you
> couldn't Mask it over to dimple?

No. A failed attempt to block does not preclude the use of Mask.

Mask of 1000 Faces - Action Modifier (obf)
* Mask cannot be used to mask an action if the Masking vampire is not

been spent.) [RTR 980623]

Again, not quite correct. Cat's Guidance and Freak Drive are played after

to

Unfortunately, again, not quite correct. As the question was posed, his
"Prey declines to block" so there is no block attempt. After the mask the
action is at 0 stealth, but his Prey has already declined to block the action
and cannot choose to attempt to block at this time. If, like a sensible
player, his prey had attempted to block with someone and failed because his
minion did not have the appropriate intercept, I do believe that the action
would be blocked. However, this is an interesting question since the minion
who was attempting to block has failed in his attempt before the mask is
played. I assume that the Mask re-evaluates the block attempt (if any) while
not allowing for a new attempt to block. From LSJ - 'A minion attempting to
block before the Mask was played is still attempting to block after the Mask
is played'-(http://deckserver.net/cgi-

No. That previous block attempt is no longer "in progress" - once the Meth.
declined to block (for lack of intercept, for instance), then there are
no blocks in progress and no further blocks to be considered.

> From LSJ - 'A minion attempting to
> block before the Mask was played is still attempting to block after the Mask

before the Meth declares "no block."
